items.name: fpds-theme
items.title: FPDS theme — tokens, light/dark, accessibility levels
items.description: src/index.css of the FleetPanda DS. Import it once at the app root.

items.name: fpds-button
items.title: Button (atom)
items.description: The one pressable action. Says what happens next. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:19. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-toggle
items.title: Toggle (atom)
items.description: A single on/off pressable — a button that stays pressed. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:87. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group (atom)
items.description: A segment control: pick one (or several) of a few short options that change a view. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:134. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-input
items.title: Input (atom)
items.description: A one-line text or number field. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:184. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-textarea
items.title: Textarea (atom)
items.description: Multi-line prose — notes, instructions, reasons. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:234. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-select
items.title: Select (atom)
items.description: Pick one value from a short fixed list. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:280. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-checkbox
items.title: Checkbox (atom)
items.description: A boolean, or one pick in a multi-pick list. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:330. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-radio-group
items.title: Radio group (atom)
items.description: Pick one of 2–4 options that each need their words visible. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:379. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-switch
items.title: Switch (atom)
items.description: Turn a setting on or off immediately, outside a table. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:426. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-slider
items.title: Slider (atom)
items.description: Choose a value or range on a continuous scale. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:473. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-label
items.title: Label (atom)
items.description: Names a field. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:520. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-calendar
items.title: Calendar (atom)
items.description: The month grid inside the date picker. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:566. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-badge
items.title: Badge (atom)
items.description: The DS's low-level chip geometry and the round counter (`BadgeNumber`). — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:616. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-pill
items.title: Pill (atom)
items.description: The chip and badge of the system — a status, tag, flag, type or "+N". — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:662. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-status-chip
items.title: Status chip (atom)
items.description: A status word, drawn as a pill in its kind's color. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:722. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-avatar
items.title: Avatar (atom)
items.description: A person's picture or initials. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:771. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-kbd
items.title: Kbd (atom)
items.description: Shows a keyboard key or shortcut. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:817. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-code-disc
items.title: Code disc (atom)
items.description: A type's initial in a 22px pastel circle, where only a letter fits. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:863. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-file-type-icon
items.title: File type icon (atom)
items.description: Shows a file's format beside its name. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:910. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-metric-icon
items.title: Metric icon (term icons) (atom)
items.description: The tile a figure card wears, and the one icon per term. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:957. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-quiet-pattern
items.title: Quiet pattern (atom)
items.description: The one decorative fill for an empty stretch of a card. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:1005. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-tooltip
items.title: Tooltip (atom)
items.description: Names an icon-only control, or why something is disabled. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:1053. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-popover
items.title: Popover (atom)
items.description: A floating panel anchored to a control. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:1100. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu (atom)
items.description: A list of actions (or checkable options) from one trigger. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:1148. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-dialog
items.title: Dialog (atom)
items.description: A focused task over the page that must be finished or dismissed. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:1196. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog (atom)
items.description: A yes/no that guards an irreversible or lossy act. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:1244. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-sheet
items.title: Sheet (atom)
items.description: The side panel primitive under every record sheet. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:1291. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-skeleton
items.title: Skeleton (atom)
items.description: Holds a part's place while it loads. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:1341. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-spinner
items.title: Spinner (atom)
items.description: A small in-place "working" mark. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:1387. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-progress
items.title: Progress (atom)
items.description: How far a known amount has got. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:1433. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-outline-shine
items.title: Outline shine (atom)
items.description: A soft band sweeping across an element's outline (or face) to draw the eye without changing it. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:1479. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-separator
items.title: Separator (atom)
items.description: A structural divider. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:1528. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area (atom)
items.description: A scrolling region with a slim custom thumb. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:1574. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-tabs
items.title: Tabs (atom)
items.description: Switch between views of one thing. — spec: docs/fpds/02-atoms.md:1620. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-search-field
items.title: Search field (molecule)
items.description: Search every column of a list from the toolbar. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:13. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-filter-chip
items.title: Filter chip (molecule)
items.description: Show which filters are on, one removable pill per facet, under the toolbar. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:63. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-icon-tool
items.title: Icon tool (molecule)
items.description: An icon-only toolbar control named by a tooltip — view switch and view tools. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:116. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-status-pill
items.title: Status pill (molecule)
items.description: A record's status in a cell, header or card — the status word in its kind's color. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:170. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-two-line-cell
items.title: Two-line cell (molecule)
items.description: A record's name with the one fact that tells it apart, in one cell. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:219. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-overflow-chip
items.title: Overflow chip (molecule)
items.description: Shows the first value and a "+N" pill that opens the rest. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:266. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-breakdown-popover
items.title: Breakdown popover (molecule)
items.description: What a "+N" chip or a total is made of. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:315. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-trend-chip
items.title: Trend chip (molecule)
items.description: The one up / down marker for a change against a period. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:363. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-copy-value
items.title: Copy value (molecule)
items.description: A read-only value with its own copy button. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:410. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-combobox
items.title: Combobox (molecule)
items.description: A select you can type into — the default picker for any list of records. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:461. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-token-multi-select
items.title: Token multi-select (molecule)
items.description: Several values for one field, shown as chips, added from a searchable list. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:517. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-date-field
items.title: Date field (molecule)
items.description: A form field that holds one date, opening the shared picker. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:568. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-time-window-slider
items.title: Time-window slider (molecule)
items.description: A time range on a drawn day, in 30-minute steps. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:620. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-hanging-add
items.title: Hanging add (molecule)
items.description: The add for a table that can grow — a tab off the card's bottom-left corner. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:668. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-stage-track
items.title: Stage track (molecule)
items.description: Where a record is in its lifecycle, or which step of a form you are on — one look for both. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:719. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-level-gauge
items.title: Level gauge (molecule)
items.description: A tank's level, its monitor's battery and its days to empty — each in its own cell. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:770. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-stat-tile
items.title: Stat tile (molecule)
items.description: A headline number on a module dashboard that opens the rows it counts. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:818. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-toast
items.title: Toast (molecule)
items.description: Confirms an act that leaves the screen, in one line. — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:867. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-empty-state
items.title: Empty state (molecule)
items.description: Tells the reader why a whole region has nothing in it (variant E3). — spec: docs/fpds/03-molecules.md:914. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-list-page
items.title: List page (template)
items.description: Show many records of one kind, let the reader narrow, sort, group, save the narrowing as a view, switch between table, board and map, open a record and act on many at once. — spec: docs/fpds/05-templates.md:12. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-record-sheet-page
items.title: Record sheet (template)
items.description: Create, edit or read ONE record in a side sheet over its list, without leaving the list. — spec: docs/fpds/05-templates.md:90. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-directory-record
items.title: Directory record (template)
items.description: Read and keep one master-data record — a customer, vendor, product or rental asset — with its properties, related records and activity. — spec: docs/fpds/05-templates.md:154. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-dashboard-page
items.title: Dashboard (template)
items.description: Answer "how are we doing today, and what needs me" for one module, and send the reader to the records behind every number. — spec: docs/fpds/05-templates.md:203. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-settings
items.title: Settings page (template)
items.description: Set how a module behaves for the whole tenant. — spec: docs/fpds/05-templates.md:251. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-app-frame
items.title: App frame (template)
items.description: The frame every page sits in: top bar, navigation, content layer. — spec: docs/fpds/05-templates.md:297. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-alert-banner
items.title: Alert banner (unit)
items.description: Tells the reader what on this list needs attention now, and lets them act on it in place: narrow the list to it, step through several kinds, act on an item, snooze or dismiss. Answers "what needs me on this page, and where is it?" — spec: docs/fpds/units/alert-banner.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-app-shell
items.title: App shell (unit)
items.description: The frame every page sits in: the top bar (brand, global search, notifications, account), the one-panel navigation (modules and their pages, Accessibility at its foot) and the content layer. It answers "where am I, where can I go, and how do I find anything". — spec: docs/fpds/units/app-shell.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-board
items.title: Board (unit)
items.description: Shows a list's records as cards in lanes, one lane per stage of the record's lifecycle, read left to right. Answers "where is every order in the work, and which ones need me?" — spec: docs/fpds/units/board.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-bulk-bar
items.title: Bulk bar & bulk edit (unit)
items.description: Acts on several ticked rows at once: change one field across them, or apply an action (archive, delete, export). Answers "do this to all of these — and show me what will change before it does." — spec: docs/fpds/units/bulk-bar.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-chip-shelf
items.title: Chip shelf (unit)
items.description: The one-line strip under the toolbar that says out loud which filters are on, and takes them off. It answers "why is this list shorter than I expect, and how do I undo it?" — spec: docs/fpds/units/chip-shelf.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-dashboard
items.title: Dashboard tiles & cards (unit)
items.description: A module's overview: a few figures, charts and short tables that say how much work there is, where it sits and what needs somebody now. In the Unified View every figure is a way into the list it counts; in the Customer Portal it is a few things for the customer to glance at, with "Attention required" first. — spec: docs/fpds/units/dashboard.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-data-table
items.title: Data table (unit)
items.description: The list's table: every record a row, every column sortable, movable and resizable, the whole row opening the record. It answers "which records match, in what order — and let me open one." — spec: docs/fpds/units/data-table.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-date-picker
items.title: Date picker (unit)
items.description: The one date picker for every screen that picks a date — a list's date filter and a form's date field alike: named presets, a calendar, typed dates, a live count, and nothing changes until Apply. It answers "which day or window do I mean, and how many records fall in it?" — spec: docs/fpds/units/date-picker.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-delivery-timeline
items.title: Delivery window & preferred time (unit)
items.description: One day drawn once, full width: the delivery window as a range on a 24-hour track, and the customer's preferred times as bars on the same scale beneath it. It answers "between when can we deliver, and when would they rather we came". — spec: docs/fpds/units/delivery-timeline.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-documents-table
items.title: Documents table (unit)
items.description: The one table for files kept on a record — BOLs, tickets, invoices, dispute evidence. It answers "what files does this record have, when did they arrive, who added them?" and, where allowed, lets the reader add one. — spec: docs/fpds/units/documents-table.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-export-sheet
items.title: Export sheet (unit)
items.description: The side sheet that opens from a list's Export button and shows exactly what is about to leave — the same rows you are looking at, the narrowings that made them, how many — before you pick a format and export. It answers "what am I exporting, and is that what I mean?" — spec: docs/fpds/units/export-sheet.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-filter-panel
items.title: Filter panel (unit)
items.description: The faceted filter behind the toolbar's **Filters** button: pick values in one or more categories, see how many rows they leave, then apply. It answers "show me only the rows with these values — and how many is that before I commit?" — spec: docs/fpds/units/filter-panel.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-lines-table
items.title: Lines table (unit)
items.description: The order's lines as an editable table: which tank or asset gets which product, and how much. It answers "what is going onto this truck, into which tank" — one row per asset, every cell typed into in place. — spec: docs/fpds/units/lines-table.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-map
items.title: Map (unit)
items.description: Shows the list's orders as a list on the left and pins at their ship-to sites on the right, one selection across both. Answers "what else is going out near this one?" — a question no column can sort. — spec: docs/fpds/units/map.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-pagination
items.title: Pagination (unit)
items.description: The footer under a list's table: where you are in the list, a way to the other pages, and how many rows a page holds. While the table is grouped, the grouped footer stands in and reports the list's shape instead. It answers "which slice am I seeing, and how do I see the rest?" — spec: docs/fpds/units/pagination.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-record-sheet
items.title: Record sheet (unit)
items.description: The right-hand side sheet that creates or edits ONE record — an order, a quote, a customer, an asset, a rule. It answers "what is this record, what does it still need, and what is the next thing to do with it?" Create and edit are the same sheet. — spec: docs/fpds/units/record-sheet.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-recurring-section
items.title: Recurring section (unit)
items.description: An optional section on any order that can repeat: a dashed "Add Recurring Order" row until it is asked for, then the recurring rule's own frequency unit in a box. It answers "does this order repeat, on which days or dates, how often, until when" — set the same way wherever a repeat is set. — spec: docs/fpds/units/recurring-section.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-standard-list
items.title: Standard list (unit)
items.description: A template-level composition written as a unit card — the whole list page in one piece, built from `unit.view-row`, `unit.toolbar`, `unit.filter-panel`, `unit.chip-shelf`, `unit.view-bar`, `unit.data-table`, `unit.export-sheet` and `unit.pagination`. Every table page, assembled the same way: the view row, the toolbar, the chip shelf, the view bar on the table, pagination, and an export that asks first. A screen hands it rows, columns, what each column prints, its facets and what Create and opening a row do. It answers "show me this kind of record as a list I can search, filter, sort, save and export" — identically on every page. — spec: docs/fpds/units/standard-list.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-status-and-awaiting
items.title: Status & awaiting pills (unit)
items.description: Says what state a record is in, as its word in a pill coloured by what the reader should do about it. The Awaiting pill says a customer's ask (change or cancellation) is waiting on the tenant, without inventing a status. Flags say what is wrong or about to be. — spec: docs/fpds/units/status-and-awaiting.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-summary-rail
items.title: Summary rail & activity (unit)
items.description: The read-only right column of a record sheet: the **Summary card** shows what the form computes (totals, counts, the headline figure), the **Activity card** shows the record's history. It answers "what has this record become?" and "what happened to it, when, by whom?". — spec: docs/fpds/units/summary-rail.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-toolbar
items.title: Toolbar (unit)
items.description: The list's control row (Pavan's original "Control unit"): narrow the list on the left (search, Filters, Group by), scope and present it on the right (date, display switch). It answers "how do I find the rows I want, and how do I want to see them?" — spec: docs/fpds/units/toolbar.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-view-bar
items.title: View bar (unit)
items.description: A strip ON the view — above the table header or above the board's lanes — that says what is shown ("62 orders · Thu, Oct 22, 2026") and carries that view's own tools. It answers "how many records am I looking at, over what window, and how do I adjust this view?" — spec: docs/fpds/units/view-bar.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.

items.name: fpds-view-row
items.title: View row (unit)
items.description: The first row of every list page: which saved narrowing you are on (All or a view you made), a way to save the current one, and the list's own actions (Create, Export). It answers "which version of this list am I looking at, and how do I add to it or take it out?" — spec: docs/fpds/units/view-row.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.
